title: Apply to FieldWorks
description: In Proposals, open the Proposal you want to apply and read its proposed changes, Rationale and evidence. Complete Before you apply, then choose Apply…. Motif activates that Proposal, reads its current review and checks whether Apply is available. Before you confirm, the question names the backup: Motif does not back up your project, so back it up in FieldWorks first (How to Back Up a Project in FieldWorks opens FieldWorks' own help). Confirm Apply only when you want those changes written to FieldWorks.
